- **Set:** `mitmproxy/tools/web/app.py` now passes `xsrf_cookie_name="_mitmproxy_xsrf"` in the Tornado application settings. This relies on Tornado supporting that setting, which I didn't check against the pinned version.
- **Read:** `web/src/js/utils.ts` now calls `getCookie("_mitmproxy_xsrf")` when it builds the `X-XSRFToken` header.

I didn't add a test. The existing tests either disable XSRF checking or don't reference the cookie name.

The built frontend under `mitmproxy/tools/web/static` wasn't touched, so it still needs a rebuild to pick up the new name.
